title_sq: SHITET NJESI SHERBIMI TEK JOENA (21 DHJETORI)!
description_sq:
Mundesi shume e mire investimi!
Shitet njesi prane supermarket Joena tek 21 Dhjetori.
Zona eshte shume e populluar dhe e favorshme per cdo lloj aktiviteti. 
Ambienti ndodhet ne katin zero te nje pallati pa ashensor duke ofruar dhe mundesin e parkimit pa pagese perpara ambientit.
Ka nje planimetri shume te rregullt kuadratike e cila e ben te pershtatshme per cdo lloj aktiviteti si Zyre Ligjore, Zyre Konsulence, Qender estetike, etj. 
Ambienti eshte investuar se fundmi ne menyre cilesore.
Aktualisht e dhene me qira me kontrate afatgjate.
Per me shume informacion ose per nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te na kontaktoni!
title_en: SERVICE UNIT FOR SALE AT JOENA (DECEMBER 21)!
description_en: Very good investment opportunity! Unit for sale near Joena supermarket on December 21. The area is very populated and favorable for any type of activity. The environment is located on the ground floor of a building without an elevator, offering the possibility of free parking in front of the environment. It has a very regular square layout which makes it suitable for any type of activity such as Legal Office, Consulting Office, Aesthetic Center, etc. The environment has recently been invested in quality. It is currently rented out with long-term contracts. For more information or for a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
